with open(path,'r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data=json.load(f)

orcid_ids=set()

def walk(x):
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        for k,v in x.items():
            walk(v)
    elif isinstance(x, list):
        for i in x:
            walk(i)
    elif isinstance(x, str):

            m=pat.search(x)
